content.text: The JWT strategy uses refreshSecret; the access token is presumably signed with auth.secret.

candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. AuthService signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (auth.service.ts ~619) and only refresh tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. Signature verification therefore fails for every fresh access token, so the guard returns 401 on every protected endpoint, even though login and refresh succeed.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in JwtStrategy instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
